programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
programs.desc: An enormous war machine lies stranded in a coastal grave along the beaches of Dagestan, Russia; experts investigate and uncover the ruins of an experimental Soviet vehicle designed to strike fear in Western governments during the Cold War.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
programs.desc: A looming skyscraper that was once an exclusive residential complex turns into a dystopian ruin in Johannesburg, South Africa; experts investigate and uncover a symbolic structure of urban decay under the shameful shadow of apartheid.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
programs.desc: The ruins of a coastal fortress sit atop a jagged outcrop along the beaches of Wales; experts investigate and uncover a derelict 19th-century British fortification that housed a series of occupants, including an exotic, private zoo.

programs.title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
